meta.description: Finetune a pretrained KERMT encoder on a labeled CSV. The skill validates the input checkpoint (must be a pretrain ckpt — grover_base / cmim / hybrid), validates the labeled CSV, prepares the data (clean + features + optional split), then launches main.py finetune inside the kermt container (detached for hours-scale runs). Hyperparameters come from agent/config/defaults_finetune.json with per-flag CLI override.

key_strengths: Exceptional safety design with mandatory targets confirmation gate (step 7) preventing silent mismatches between user intent and execution
Sophisticated auto-detection: targets from CSV columns, sibling val/test CSVs for pre-split datasets
Comprehensive split strategy support (random, scaffold_balanced, index_predetermined) with clear guidance on when to use each
Strong security with shell metacharacter quoting guidance and consent gate for model download
Clear DDP vs single-GPU documentation with per-GPU batch size semantics and multi-model/k-fold CV support

recommendations.title: Move step 5 pre-flight logic to reference file
recommendations.problem: 304 lines exceeds target; step 5 pre-flight (sibling CSV detection) and quoting guidance add ~30 lines
recommendations.root_cause: Complex data preparation logic inlined for immediate accessibility
recommendations.fix: Create references/data-preparation.md covering sibling split detection, shell quoting, and mount patterns; keep 2-3 line summary in step 5 with pointer to full guidance

recommendations.title: Add concrete example for task-specific FFN heads
recommendations.problem: Multi-task learning heads feature documented with parameter names but no example showing when/why to use
recommendations.root_cause: Advanced feature assumed to be self-documenting from parameter names
recommendations.fix: Add to Optional inputs after task-specific parameters: 'Example: heterogeneous multi-target finetune with 3 ADME properties and 2 toxicity endpoints → --ffn-num-task-specific-layers 2 --ffn-task-specific-hidden-size 256 gives each target its own 2-layer FFN head for specialized feature learning.'

recommendations.title: Clarify resume-finetune task identity verification issue
recommendations.problem: Common errors mentions skill doesn't support resume because task identity can't be verified but explanation is brief
recommendations.root_cause: Technical constraint documented without full context
recommendations.fix: Expand common errors: 'Resume not supported because saved checkpoint's task FFN heads are sized to the original target columns — if new CSV has different column names, order, or count, loading would fail or silently mismatch. For same-dataset resume, use manual main.py call which skips validation.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for repeated finetunes
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running finetune multiple times with same inputs produces identical results
recommendations.root_cause: Stochasticity from data splitting and weight initialization
recommendations.fix: Add to Hard rules: 'Idempotency: finetuning is stochastic due to random splits (unless index_predetermined) and weight initialization. Same checkpoint and CSV with consistent --seed should produce reproducible results via cmd_replay, but expect minor variation from system-level randomness.'
